title: Fluffy Bao with Jubilant Fried Rice
description: A Chinese-inspired breakfast dish featuring fluffy bao and jubilant fried rice. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Jubilant Fried Rice
ingredients.notes: Leftover rice works best for this recipe

instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon of sesame oil in a pan over medium heat.
Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce to the pan and stir.
Add the fluffy bao to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the scrambled eggs and green onions to the pan and stir.
Add the jubilant fried rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
